services.title: Broasted Chicken
services.blurb: Speck's award-winning Broasted chicken by the piece, bucket, or combo, in equal assortments of breasts, legs, thighs, and wings. Large party orders welcome with 3 days' notice.

services.title: Sandwiches & Hoagies
services.blurb: Burgers made like homemade with fresh ground beef, hot dogs, fish and crab cake sandwiches, and hoagies dressed with provolone, onion, tomato, oil, and oregano.

services.title: Steak Sandwiches
services.blurb: Chicken or beef steak sandwiches on a long roll, plain, cheese steak, or a full steak hoagie, in three sizes.

services.title: Sides & Soups
services.blurb: Coleslaw, macaroni salad, potato salad, garden salad, and a hot vegetable of the day, plus daily soups and chowders and Wednesday chili.

services.title: Kids Meals & Milkshakes
services.blurb: Kids meals with applesauce, a kiddie side, and a choice of juice or milk, plus milkshakes in nine flavors.

about: In 1953, Stanley B. Landis, known as Speck, started the original Speck's Drive-In on Ridge Pike in Limerick on the idea of Pipin' Hot Sandwiches and good, affordable fast food, years before fast-food franchises defined the American landscape. After a fire at the Big Pixie location at Ridge and Germantown Pikes, Speck acquired the property and ran both locations. The Limerick spot changed hands over the years, but the Collegeville location has stayed in the family, with Speck's children, their spouses, and his grandchildren holding roles over the decades. Today Speck's son Randy still owns the restaurant and is heavily involved in daily operations. The restaurant remains known for its sandwiches, with the Broasted chicken and homemade coleslaw as the primary draw. Speck's is a Collegeville landmark and often the first stop for people coming back to the area.

faq.q: How long has Speck's been in Collegeville?
faq.a: Speck's Drive-In has been a family owned and operated establishment since 1953, and the Collegeville location has stayed in the family ever since.

faq.q: Do you take large party orders?
faq.a: Yes. Large party orders are welcome for chicken buckets of 24 pieces or more; call 3 days ahead to ensure availability.

faq.q: Can I order online or get delivery?
faq.a: Yes. Order for pickup online, or get delivery through the restaurant's listed delivery partners.
